Titanium Shackles are provided by Captain Keyton for Human Infestation.

To All the Squirrels Who Cared for Me is an exploration achievement earned for using /love emote on each of the critters found across Azeroth after the cataclysm. It involves finding a number of critters introduced with Cataclysm and using the /love emote on them.

To Raene Wolfrunner continues the Dartol's Rod quest chain. In this quest chain, Alliance adventurers are asked to complete Teronis' work, namely, to re-assemble a rod that may help the night elves deal with the corrupted furbolg of Ashenvale. As a friend of Teronis, Raene will instruct the adventurer how to proceed.
To Saurfang of the Horde is provided for the quest Saurfang's Blessing.

This rogue-only quest is the third part of the chain to obtain the legendary dagger set Fangs of the Father. It transports the rogue to Ravenholdt Manor, the base of operations for the rest of the quest chain.
Titanguard Wristplates are created with Blacksmithing (525); taught by Plans: Titanguard Wristplates.

To Be A Pandaren can be found on a bench not far from Master Shang Xi at the Shang Xi Training Grounds on the Wandering Isle. It begins the quest Much to Learn as a contingency for players who somehow abandon the quest.
Titanium Siegebreakers are iron vrykul located in the Halls of Lightning.
Titanium Thunderers are iron vrykul located in the Halls of Lightning.

To All The Squirrels I Once Caressed? is an exploration achievement earned for using /love emote on each of the critters found across Pandaria. It involves finding a number of critters around Pandaria and using the /love emote on them.

Titan Runestones are a semi-rare drop from the last six bosses (plus Ra-den) in Throne of Thunder and from the first eight bosses in Siege of Orgrimmar in all difficulty levels. Lei Shen, Ra-den, and the Sha of Pride have a guaranteed chance to drop a runestone. Titan Runestones are personal loot. Players only have a single chance each week to loot a runestone from each boss, no matter the difficulty level, and the chance of winning a runestone is the same on all difficulty levels. Should players run LFR first each lockout, they will not be eligible to loot a runestone if they later kill the same boss in normal or Heroic mode.
Titan Sparks are sparks found in the Forge of the Endless in Mogu'shan Vaults.
__NOTOC__ Tito's Basket is a reward from Raiding with Leashes II: Attunement Edition.
Titanic Corruption is a sha found during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Tix is a rare silithid reaver that can be found just north of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj instance portal in Ahn'Qiraj: The Fallen Kingdom.
Titanstrike is the artifact used by beast mastery hunters in World of Warcraft: Legion. When it was created, it was Azeroth's first firearm.
Tizare is a jungle troll follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

.]] The titan-forged (also known as the seed races or the "titanspawn") were the armies crafted by the Pantheon from Azeroth's crust to fight the Black Empire of the Old Gods. The keepers would later create more titan-forged through the twin forges, the Forge of Wills and the Forge of Origination, in order to compensate the number of titan-forged lost during the War on the Black Empire. Aedis, Tarneth and the dark keepers of Antorus are keepers separate from Azeroth's who have sided with Sargeras in his Burning Crusade.
Titan-Forged Locket is a quest reward from Thinly Veiled Threats.
Tizaksul is an employee for Blizzard Entertainment and serves in the role of Forum Engagement for the European World of Warcraft forums. He or she was introduced by Aerythlea on August 14, 2017.
Titan Sentries are titan orbs floating in and out of the Makers' Overlook in Sholazar Basin.
Titanslayer is a title rewarded from Mythic: Argus the Unmaker. The title will show before the character's name, in the following format: :Titanslayer
__NOTOC__ The Titan Console can be found within the Chamber of Heart. Interacting with it replays the Antorus, the Burning Throne ending cinematic.
The Titan Translocator is a transportation pad in Silithus: The Wound used to gain access to the Chamber of Heart.
The Titan's Cache appears upon defeat of Yogg-Saron in Ulduar.
Titan Keeper Shavras is a deceased titanic watcher located in in Nazwatha, Nazmir. Near his body is Keeper Shavras's Core which is needed to repair Titan Keeper Hezrel's auxiliary systems.
Titan Keeper Bolcan is a damaged titanic watcher located in Nazwatha, Nazmir. His data core is needed to repair Titan Keeper Hezrel's auxiliary systems.
Titan Residuum (abbreviated as TR) is a Battle for Azeroth currency. It is used to purchase Azerite armor.
Tizzy Gearjolt is a gnome located just outside Ruff Waters in Hook Point in Boralus.
Titan Platings drop from Nazwathan Spectres in Zuldazar for Recovering Remnants.

The Titanic Stone Legguards drop from the Ancient Stone Keeper in the Temple Hall in Uldaman.
The Titanic Guardian can be found on the ground level of the Chamber of the Sun in Uldum. Unless players activate it during the below quest, it remains immobile and non-interactive.
Titan Artifacts are found throughout Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.

The Titanic Research Archive is a machine located in the Chamber of Heart. The console is used to unlock research with Corrupted Mementos. The archive goes online after completing Accessing the Archives.
Titanic Core drops from an Ivory Watcher and Watcher Rehu in Uldum.
Titanus Egg is an aqir egg located in the western Ruins of Ammon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. It will hatch into a Titanus Young.
Tisiphon is a hydra summoned by Danielle's Lucky Fishing Rod in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
To Kill Demons... is an exploration achievement earned by slaying 500 non-trivial demons in Krokuun, Eredath, and the Antoran Wastes.
Tirnenn Saplings are located in the Oaken Assembly in the Mists of Tirna Scithe.

The tirnenn are an enigmatic tree-like race native to Ardenweald. They are the eldest of the Fae Court—quiet, thoughtful, and generally friendly unless outsiders threaten their groves. Although they are slow to action as well as anger, they are terrible to behold in battle as they are capable of shaping the land and flora around their enemies with startling speed. The tirnenn are responsible for much of the maintenance and crafting work in Ardenweald, such as creating root archways by sticking their arms into the soil and forcing roots out of the ground. Tithris is a bronze drakonid innkeeper located in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken. After the events of A Curious Orb during Secrets of Azeroth, Tithris wanders off and Marinth replaces him. He attacked the adventurer in Tyrhold in Valdrakken but was defeated.
To All the Squirrels Hidden Till Now is an exploration achievement earned by showing /love to the critters of Dragon Isles.
To My Staunchest Allies is looted from an Ancient Volume in Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr. It is a message from Tyr, to be delivered upon his death to Ironaya and Archaedas.

Titan's Torment is a warrior class talent. It is only available for Fury warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with Berserker's Torment.

To'tik is a tuskarr located in the Lost Ruins in the Azure Span.

Titan Rune Dungeons (often referred to as Heroic+) is an optional game mode that can be activated with the Mysterious Device in heroic dungeons that were introduced with . Upon activating the device, enemies throughout the dungeon will have increased the health and damage as well as a new thematic gameplay effect based on the theme of the dungeon. This game mode is similar to Mythic+ from retail.
Titan Temple Relics are scattered throughout Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
To All the Squirrels Burrowed Beneath is an exploration achievement earned by making the critters of Zaralek Cavern avoid the light of the sun, but not the light of your /love.

Titanic Hourglass is sold for by Sorotis at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Titan's Containment Device is a quest reward from A Sliver of Silver. Using it makes the adventurer Contained for 5 minutes.

Orbs appear randomly after defeating enemies, and they provide random effects, similar to Anima Cells in Torghast.

Titan Key Mold is found in the Ancient Key Mold at hidden in the leaves near the Cloverwood Hollow of Sylvan Glade in the Ohn'ahran Plains. On day eight of Secrets of Azeroth, players were given the The Blacksmith and the Apprentice note after A Key Story, which led players to the ruined building. The mold starts A Titanic Mold, which ends the day eight activities.

Titan-Inscribed Tablets are found in the caves of Stormshroud Peak in Thaldraszus. They can be revealed with the Torch of Pyrreth. They hint towards the locations of Buried Objects, revealed to be a Piece of the Orb of Rathmus.
The Titan Energy Core is looted from a Broken Urn on the top ring of the central area at Tyrhold in Thaldraszus. It can be combined with the Titan Cube Housing to create a Titan Energy Cube.
The Titan Cube Housing is looted from a Broken Urn on the top ring of the central area at Tyrhold in Thaldraszus. It can be combined with the Titan Energy Core to create a Titan Energy Cube.
Titan Energy Cube is created by combining the Titan Energy Core and the Titan Cube Housing.
Titan Focusing Crystal is looted from a Broken Urn on the middle ring of the central area at Tyrhold in Thaldraszus.
Titan Block Key Fragments are looted from a Broken Urn on the bottom ring of the central area at Tyrhold in Thaldraszus. Two are needed to create a Titan Block Key.
The Titan Block Key is created by combining two Titan Block Key Fragment.

The Tome of Divinity is a book of great value to the Clerics of Northshire Abbey. During the First War it somehow ended up in the clutches of Turok and his band of ogres. Anduin Lothar led an expedition into the Deadmines to recapture the tome, but the ogres emerged victorious in the dark depths of the mines. Anduin and a few survivors were captured and made prisoners to be killed slowly. In a vision Anduin Lothar was seen alive, and he was rescued by soldiers from Stormwind. The Tome of Divinity was taken out of the mine with Lothar, though Turok was not stopped. Finally the tome was returned to Northshire Abbey. It is currently used in the training of new paladins of the Silver Hand in bot
Tomb Horrors are crypt fiends located in the Arachnid Quarter in Naxxramas.
Tombstone Breastplate is a leather chest armor popular with rogues and feral druids for its increased critical strike chance.

Tom Chilton (aliases Kalgan and Evocare) is a game designer at Blizzard Entertainment and former game director for World of Warcraft. After working on World of Warcraft from its alpha in 2004 to the release of Legion, in late 2016 Chilton announced that he would be leaving the team to "[focus] on another project within the company". In 2022, it was revealed he worked on Warcraft Arclight Rumble mobile game and is the game director of this game.

Tome of Fiery Redemption is an epic trinket for paladins. It represents a significant threat boost for protection paladins, as - in addition to the casting of spells - it will proc from Consecration ticks, Judgment refreshes, and mana/health gains from Seal of Light. This means that paladins will receive the spell damage bonus almost immediately at the beginning of a fight. It has a 15% proc chance, a 45 second hidden cooldown and lasts 15 seconds.
Tome of Arcane Brilliance drops from trash mobs and bosses in level 50+ dungeons and raid instances.
Tome of Fireball drops from bosses in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. At the time of its adding the tome was the only way for mages to learn the Fireball XII spell.
Tome of Arcane Missiles drops from bosses in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

Tobias Seecher is a level 52 prisoner inside the Halls of the Law of Blackrock Depths. He is a member of Marshal Reginald Windsor's former band of heroes, but was captured by the Dark Iron dwarves alongside the marshal.
Toast is a spell effect (buff) from having been toasted (with a Toasting Goblet) during the New Year's celebration. It grants +20 Stamina for 30 minutes.
The Toasting Goblet is found on inn tables in the cities of Azeroth. It is only available during the New Year, ending of Midsummer Fire Festival and Lunar Festival.

Toby "Mother Goose" Ironbolt is a gnomish stable master located at Fizzcrank Airstrip in the Borean Tundra. At one point he captured a rhino for use as a mount. The shaggy beast carries an enormous grudge after being bridled by a gnome.
__NOTOC__ Toalu'u the Mystic is a tuskarr located at Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight.
To Thrall, Warchief of the Horde is provided for the quest Warchief's Blessing (Wrath Classic).
The Tome of Arcane Phenomena can be looted from the Cache of Eregos after defeating Ley-Guardian Eregos in the Oculus on normal mode.
Tokyopop, styled TOKYOPOP, is the publisher of the Warcraft and World of Warcraft manga.

To the Looter Go the Spoils is a player vs. player achievement earned for looting the Autographed Picture of Tigule from the corpses of players in Alterac Valley.
To The Rescure! is a player vs. player achievement earned for coming to the defense of a base in Arathi Basin 50 times by recapping the flag.
The Tome of Dalaran Brilliance is just a luxury item and has no added functional benefit. Using this book will teach you Dalaran Brilliance.

Before Patch 4.0.1 removed Dalaran Intellect from the game and replaced all instances of this item with Tomes of Dalaran Brilliance, the Tome of Dalaran Intellect was just a luxury item and had no added functional benefit. Using this book would teach you Dalaran Intellect.
Tokens of the Descendants is the repeatable version of Adversarial Blood. This quest allows a player to get more Time-Lost Offerings to summon and defeat Terokk for Terokk's Downfall.

in the background.]] The Tomb of the Watchers is a dig site in the Badlands that shares an appearance with that of Uldaman. Both Alliance and Horde excavators scour and hammer away at the land nearby, as the Alliance camp of Dustwind Dig overlooks it from the hills and the Horde camp of Bloodwatcher Point sits nearby. Oddly, the minimap shows the dirt around it as a rather different color than it is, likely due to a texturing change. Dwarven artifacts can be retrieved from this archaeology dig site.
Tog Rustsprocket is a gnome located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was motivated by Gelbin Mekkatorque during the Operation: Gnomeregan. He was present during the Legion invasions.

The Tomb of the Sun King is the tomb of Sun King Nahkotep, leader of the Amathet tol'vir, in southeastern Uldum. A group of cursed gnomes are trying to gain access to the tomb using an extreme amount of large explosives. The M.A.C. Diver is parked right beside the tomb. The Tomb of the Sun King has been occupied by the Amathet and Sun King Nahkotep, a group of tol'vir who believe only they can protect the titans' works.

Tol Barad Commendations are currency used to purchase items sold by Pogg and Quartermaster Brazie on the Tol Barad Peninsula. Commendations are rewarded from daily quests offered in either Tol Barad zone. You also receive 3 commendations for taking part in a Tol Barad victory for your faction. There are two sets of quest hubs: one on Tol Barad Peninsula that always available, regardless of who controls Baradin Keep, and another on Tol Barad at Baradin Keep, which is available to the faction that controls it: On Tol Barad Peninsula, four NPCs offer a total of six quests from the 22 possible: *Commander Marcus Johnson / Commander Larmash ** Claiming The Keep ** Leave No Weapon Behind ** Not Th
Tol Barad Coconut Rum is sold by bartenders around the world.
Togrik's Legguards are a quest reward from The Tortusk Takedown.
__NOTOC__ Tock Sprysprocket is a gnome quest giver found in New Tinkertown.

The Tomb of the Earthrager is a room in the Halls of Origination. It is the location where Earthrager Ptah is fought. It is a massive outdoor area where mountable camel vehicles (allowing one to cast while moving) can be used. The eponymous tomb behind Ptah is the reorigination device itself.

Tol'viron Arena (also spelled Tol'Viron Arena in the finder UI) is located in Uldum, and was introduced with Mists of Pandaria. It is the sixth arena map, and the first arena to be introduced since the Dalaran Sewers (not including the revamped Ring of Valor). It is a heavily modified version of the Ruins of Ammon. The map's design is based on the simplistic Nagrand Arena. The only difference between the two arenas is the art style and the direction of the pillars. To the Aid of the Thorium Brotherhood is a quest introducing the player to both the Searing Gorge area and the reputation faction Thorium Brotherhood. It is the starting quest for the Searing Gorge quest chain along with the quests Hero's Call: Searing Gorge! and Warchief's Command: Searing Gorge!.
Tol Barad Veteran is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning 25 battles of Tol Barad.

Tobin is a draenei found walking among a small group viewing the Exodar Holographic Emitters within the Vault of Lights in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.

Togrik is a female orc quest giver, located at Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens. She enlists the player's aid in determining the reason for the quilboar attacks on the farm. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Tomb Guardians are mogu located in the Tomb of Shadows in Kun-Lai Summit. Some of them have been frozen.
Tomb Watchers are undead mogu located in the Tomb of Shadows in Kun-Lai Summit.

The Tomb of Shadows is the first crypt accessed in the Valley of Emperors. Immediately above the crypt is the unnamed Zandalari camp, just to the west is the entrance to the Tomb of Conquerors, while across the way up the stairs on the next level is the entrance to the Tomb of Secrets.

The Tomb of Secrets is the second crypt accessed in the Valley of Emperors. Down the steps to the east on the lower level is the entrance to the Tomb of Shadows, the Tomb of Conquerors is due north from the Tomb of Secrets' entrance, also on the lower level, while the Shrine of the Merciless One and Emperor Rikktik's Rest are up the hill to the west.

The Tomb of Conquerors was the final resting place of the Thunder King, Lei Shen, the first Emperor of the mogu empire. It is the largest tomb in the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit, west of the Temple of the White Tiger. Near the end of the Zandalari Troll Wars, realizing that they had no way to win by conventional means against the pandaren cloud serpent riders, the Zandalari trolls, led by Mengazi, intended to resurrect the Thunder King to turn the tide of the war. A great battle erupted near the tomb, only ending when Jiang, leader of the serpent riders, sacrificed herself to kill Mengazi and send the trolls fleeing back to their homeland in shame. Together, We Are Strong is a wood-panel scroll leaning against the leg of a mogu statue, found at on the southwestern ridge of Ruins Rise in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Interacting with the scroll is a requirement of the Pandaria exploration achievement What Is Worth Fighting For.
__NOTOC__ Tol'vir Scarabs are carrion beetles located in Uldum.

A Tombstone is shown next to the open grave that was formerly occupied by undead players in Deathknell, shortly before they are officially raised from the dead by the val'kyr Agatha in Fresh out of the Grave.
Tol Barad Victory is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning a battle of Tol Barad.

__NOTOC__ Tolyria is a blood elf blacksmith found in the Forge of Fate of Dalaran. Tolyria is one of the shopkeepers that did not side with the Silver Covenant, during the purge of Dalaran, and because of this her death was ordered by Vereesa Windrunner.

To the Skies! begins the fourth stage of the Isle of Thunder storyline, gaining access to the Lightning Vein Mine and the Thunder Forges. Jaina will only offer this quest from her position on the Violet Rise once enough realm-wide progress has been made, irrespective of the individual player's standing with the Kirin Tor Offensive. Much like with the previous progression quest, Tear Down This Wall! (Alliance), this quest mostly takes place in a single-player scenario, also called "To the Skies!". As the scenario can only be completed once, it is documented here and not in a separate article.
Tomb Stalkers are found in the Culling of Stratholme. They also appear in The Deaths of Chromie.
__NOTOC__ Tolv the Impatient is a human located in the Molten Fields of the Molten Front.
Tom Wat is a level 8 pandaren found on a dock in Krasarang Wilds.
Tog the Earthrender is a large magnaron found fighting with Ula at the Fertile Ground in Gorgrond.
Tom Thompson is lead software engineer for World of Warcraft, and is involved with work on the user interface. In late 2016 Thompson celebrated 10 years with Blizzard.
The Tome of Chaos drops from bosses in . Unlike the previous items in the quest chain, it is not a guaranteed drop.
The Tomb of Souls is a draenei crypt that is part of the complex in Talador. The entrance to the crypt is from the Court of Souls. It is home to a vignette mob, Shirzir.
Toega is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Tome of Fel Secrets drops from Prolifica in the Foul Creche on Mardum.
Todd Stone is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.

The Tomb of Tyr (or Keeper's Rest) is an underground area located under the lake of Tyr's Fall in the Whispering Forest in western Tirisfal Glades. It is accessible from a narrow entrance at the bottom of the lake. The area is comprised of the Vestibule of the Silver Hand, Tyr's tomb, the Darkwalk, and the prison of Zakajz the Corruptor.
Token of a Master Cultivator is a quest reward from Bad Apples.

The Tomb of the Old Kings is a crypt found on Shield's Rest in Stormheim. Several vrykul kings were buried here, their tomb protected by traps and vrykul spirits. During the Burning Legion's invasion of the Broken Isles, adventurers plundered three of its treasures. First, a warrior came to challenge Magnar Icebreaker in order to reclaim the Scale of the Earth-Warder. Next, a paladin came to challenge Yrgrim the Truthseeker for Truthguard. Finally, the spirit of Warlord Volund was disturbed by a hunter in order to take Titanstrike.

The Tomb of the Icebreaker is the final resting place of Magnar Icebreaker and several of his loyal soldiers, found as the southernmost chamber of the Tomb of the Old Kings on Shield's Rest in Stormheim. Hruthnir and the warrior adventurer come here to confront Magnar's spirit during Legacy of the Icebreaker.

Toki represents the "Time-Tinker" class in the single-player experience.

Tor'kren Farm is located southeast of Thunder Ridge and north of the Southfury Watershed in northwestern Durotar. It narrowly missed being flooded by the Southfury River during the Cataclysm. It hasn't seen as much profit as other pig farms in the area. It was previously run by Misha Tor'kren and her son Kron, before Kron's death several years ago while hunting crocolisks in the Southfury River. Misha now runs the farm alone, and while on the quest Watershed Patrol she will ask for help creating a crocolisk tooth necklace in memory of her son.
